reason: Integrates DSH with OverleafMCP to browse, read, and update multiple Overleaf projects through MCP tools and Git commits, requiring an Overleaf token.

summaries.zh: 通过 OverleafMCP 将 DSH 连接到多个 Overleaf 项目，以便浏览、读取并通过 Git 提交更新项目文件和章节。
summaries.en: Connects DSH to multiple Overleaf projects through OverleafMCP for browsing, reading, and updating project files and sections via Git commits.

capabilities: Reads files and section content from configured Overleaf projects
Writes files or sections to Overleaf through Git commits
Uses an Overleaf Git integration token
Starts OverleafMCP through MCP stdio and exposes its tools to DSH
